note: First follow trial on the robot: robot.json's unmeasured defaults, plus a detector height window that reaches the floor (a balloon lying on the floor is followed). Not a calibration; measure robot.json with ROBOT_FOLLOW_CHECKLIST.md for real use.

camera.measured: NOT MEASURED: robot.json defaults (from sim), dated so a first follow trial can run (Elham, 2026-11-04)
camera.how: python -m gpt_astra.tools.check_camera --write gpt_astra/calibration/robot.json (balloon at taped spots, robot standing still or in the gantry)
camera.rotation_note: columns: camera x (image right), y (image up), z (backwards) in the pelvis frame

balloon.measured: NOT MEASURED: robot.json defaults (from sim), dated so a first follow trial can run (Elham, 2026-11-04)
balloon.how: same check_camera session: the balloon's real diameter, red thresholds under the lab lights, no detections without the balloon or on red clothing
balloon.trial_note: 0.45 instead of 0.08 (2026-11-04): the balloon's cord in front of it split the red disk; 0.08 kept 68 of 781 balloon frames of the first follow run, 0.45 keeps 771. A red rectangle fits at ~0.11, so red clothing near the robot now counts as a balloon.

grab.measured: NOT MEASURED: robot.json defaults (from sim), dated so a first follow trial can run (Elham, 2026-11-04)
grab.how: run.py --grab-check in the gantry with tools/record_lowstate.py, then tools/grab_report.py --write

walk.measured: NOT MEASURED: robot.json defaults (from sim), dated so a first follow trial can run (Elham, 2026-11-04)
walk.how: run.py --walk-check on the floor (gantry slack) with a balloon on a stand, then tools/walk_report.py --write; the speeds must equal the robot build's WALK_SPEED/FINE_WALK_SPEED

safety.note: Trial limits (2026-11-04, after the first follow run): the 1 m fence stopped all walking after three short sidesteps (dead reckoning at commanded speed over-reads), and 0.3 s cut every walk while the far balloon flickered in view. fence 5 m (~1.5 m real), keep walking 1 s toward the last sighting.

trial_changes: 2026-11-04 after the second follow run: fence 100 m (off; dead reckoning counted slow steps taken in place as 3.6 m), fine_within 0 (the 0.2 m/s steps stepped in place, so walk only at 0.4 m/s), still_tolerance 0.08 m (the corded balloon's estimate jitters ~4 cm per frame). still_tolerance 10 m (stillness check off for now, Elham: fix the still count later): the robot only has to stand 0.6 s with the balloon in view, so it closes in and grabs even while the balloon moves.
